name: motionx-product-film
description: 55-second 2D motion-graphics product film for MotionX Shot Studio (Remotion).

scripts.studio: npm run assets && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run assets && remotion render src/index.ts ProductFilm out/motionx-shot-studio-demo.mp4 --codec=h264 --pixel-format=yuv420p --crf=16 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=192k
